# A name for the repair cafe

The library has offered a room for a monthly repair cafe. The name makes the project sound more settled than it is. Before printing posters, decide which repairs we can refuse and how visitors will know. The summer repair table was useful because diagnosis counted as an outcome. Put that promise in [[Repair ideas]], alongside a maximum number of bookings rather than an unlimited invitation.
